title: Scale invariance of the fourth-moment condition
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\mu$, let $B,c\in\mathbb{R}$ with $c\ne0$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The conditions $1\le B$ and $\mathbb{E}_{\mu}[(cX)^4]\le B\bigl(\mathbb{E}_{\mu}[(cX)^2]\bigr)^2$ hold if and only if $1\le B$ and $\mathbb{E}_{\mu}[X^4]\le B\bigl(\mathbb{E}_{\mu}[X^2]\bigr)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite probability space and probability mass function
